blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models now generate code, documentation, and analyses, and are increasingly used to review such output. We ask when a second review by a different model helps. Building on the author’s earlier preprints, which varied context, repetition, and role structure within one model, we test model independence in a controlled experiment: 30 artifacts with 150 planted errors, 10 review conditions, and 900 review sessions with three reviewer models from two developers. In this experiment, (1) a top-tier cross-model reviewer is not significantly different in F1 from same-model review in a fresh session (CCR), which does not establish equivalence; (2) the two find partly different errors (Jaccard 41.2%); and (3) at two review calls, one CCR plus one cross-model review matches more planted errors than two CCR reviews (56.7% vs. 42.7%; Holm-adjusted p = .006 p=.006 ), but not significantly more than two reviews by the top-tier cross-model reviewer, so model difference and reviewer capability are not separated. A lightweight cross-model reviewer scores no higher than same-model review. Withholding requirements from the reviewer raises F1 for the two lower tiers but not the top tier, in untested point estimates whose pattern depends on how failed sessions are scored. Before analysis we audited all session records, excluding one baseline run of uncertain provenance and 14 failed calls; results with all sessions are also reported. A partial check on public detector outputs from another benchmark neither replicates nor contradicts the main comparison. Records, artifacts, and scripts are available from the author on request.
blocks.zh: 大型语文模型现在产生代码、文件和分析,并越来越多地用于审查这种产出。 我们问,由不同模式进行的第二次审查何时有帮助。 根据作者先前的预印本,在一个模型中不同背景、重复和角色结构,我们在一个有控制的实验中测试模型的独立性:30件艺术品,150个植入错误,10个审查条件,900次审查会,两个开发商的3个审查人模型。 在这项实验中, (1)在F1中,顶级跨型审查器与在新会话(CCR)中同型审查器没有显著的区别,没有确定等效性; (2)两人发现部分不同的错误(Jaccard 41.2%); (3)在两次审查电话中,一个CCR加一个跨型审查器比两个CCR审查器匹配更多的植入错误(56.7%对42.7%;Holm调整p=.006 p=.006),但顶级跨型审查器的两次审查器没有明显超过两次,因此模型差异和审查器能力没有分离. 轻量级跨型审查者得分不高于同型审查. 在未经测试的点数估计中,审查者不保留要求为两个低级但为最高级提高F1,其模式取决于如何打分失败。 在分析之前,我们审计了所有届会记录,不包括一个来源不明的基准运行和14次失败的呼叫;还报告了所有届会的结果。 从另一个基准部分检查公共探测器输出,既不复制也不违背主要比较。 记录、文物和脚本可向作者索取。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) now generate code, documentation, data analyses, and research artifacts faster than people can review them. This has motivated the use of LLMs themselves as reviewers, an approach that is already gaining industrial traction, as evidenced by the recent release of cross-model review tooling integrated directly into AI coding assistants ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . Two questions are open: what makes AI review of AI output independent, and does cross-model review improve defect detection?
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)现在生成代码,文档,数据分析,以及研究文物的速度比人们所能审查的速度要快. 这促使LLMs本身被用作审查者,这种做法已经在获得工业上的吸引力,最近发布的跨模型审查工具直接纳入AI编码助理(OpenAI, 2026)就证明了这一点。 两个问题尚未解决:为什么AI审查AI输出会独立,跨模型审查会改善缺陷检测?

blocks.en: Verification is only as useful as it is independent of what produced the output. In human contexts, peer review, double-blind evaluation, and independent auditing all derive their value from ensuring that the verifier’s judgment is not contaminated by the same biases that produced the original output. When the same LLM reviews its own generation within the same conversational context, it shares its training data, parameters, and conversational context, and in-context self-correction without external feedback has been found to degrade accuracy ( Huang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 核查的用处在于它独立于产出。 在人的情况下,同行审查、双盲评价和独立审计都从确保核查员的判断不受产生原始产出的同样偏见的污染出发。 当同一LLM在同一个对话语境下审查自己的生成时,它分享自己的训练数据,参数和对话语境,并且发现没有外部反馈的内涵自我校正会降低精度(Huang等人,2024年).

blocks.en: A series of earlier studies by the author explored individual dimensions of independence within one model. Cross-Context Review ( Song, 2026a , CCR;) reported that context independence (removing the generation conversation before review) improves defect detection; in the data reused here, after excluding one baseline run of uncertain provenance, CCR exceeds same-context self-review by only 1.5pp in F1, which is not significant (Section 5.1 ). Diachronic CCR ( Song, 2026c , D-CCR;) reported that temporal independence (adding repeated review rounds) is counterproductive, increasing false positives by 62% without improving recall. In a study whose main subject is benchmark-contamination detection, the Hierarchical Cross-Context Architecture report ( Song, 2026b , HCCA;) also describes a pilot in which a multi-stage pipeline (worker, verifier, director) whose later stages could see earlier conclusions produced only sycophantic confirmation, and identify information restriction rather than structural complexity as the key mechanism. These three reports are the author’s own single-author preprints that have not been peer reviewed, so we do not rely on their conclusions: every baseline number below is recomputed from the per-session data, the benchmark and matching procedure are specified in Appendix A , and where our test disagrees with an earlier report we say so.
blocks.zh: 作者先前的一系列研究在一种模式中探讨了独立性的各个层面。 Cross-Context Review (Song, 2026a, CCR;)) 报告说,上下文独立(在审查前删除生成对话)可以改善缺陷检测;在此重用的数据中,排除一个不确定出处的基线运行后,CCR在F1中仅超过1.5pp的同文自我审查,并不重要(第5.1节). Diachronic CCR (Song, 2026c, D-CCR;) 报告说,时间独立性(加上反复的审查回合)适得其反,虚假阳性增加62%,没有改善召回. 在一项以基准污染检测为主体的研究中,"等级跨文本架构报告"(Song, 2026b, HCCA;)也描述了一个实验项目,其中一个多阶段管道(工人,核查员,导演)的后期阶段只能看到早期的结论只产生共鸣的确认,并确定信息限制而不是结构复杂性作为关键机制. 这三份报告是作者自己的单一作者的预印本,没有经过同行评审,所以我们不依赖他们的结论:下面的每一个基准数都是从每次会议的数据中重算出来的,基准和匹配程序在附录A中有明确规定,而我们的测试与早先的一份报告不一致的,我们这样说。

blocks.en: All three studies stayed within one model. The most intuitive form of independence, using a different model, remained untested. This paper addresses that gap.
blocks.zh: 所有这三项研究都停留在一个模式之内。 采用不同模式的最直观的独立形式仍然没有经过检验。 本文涉及这一差距。

blocks.en: We introduce a four-dimensional framework for independence in LLM verification, encompassing context, temporal, structural, and model independence. Through a controlled experiment with 900 review sessions across 10 conditions, we systematically evaluate model independence and its interaction with other dimensions. Our key findings are:
blocks.zh: 我们在LLM核查方面引入了一个四维独立框架,包括背景、时间、结构和模式独立。 通过在10个条件下对900次审查会议进行有控制的试验,我们系统地评价模式的独立性及其与其他层面的互动。 我们的主要调查结果是:

blocks.en: We use complementary to mean partially non-overlapping detection, not super-additive coverage. (1) Complementary detection : cross-model review (XMR) and CCR find partly different defects (Jaccard 41.2%), with CCR ahead on code (F1 40.7%) and XMR on documents (F1 up to 42.1%); (2) call-matched coverage : one CCR plus one XMR review matches 56.7% of planted errors against 42.7% for two CCR reviews, while the gain over two top-tier XMR reviews is not significant; (3) reviewer capability appears to shape the effect —a top-tier reviewer shows no significant difference from CCR, but a lightweight model scores numerically below even baseline same-context review, so the value of model independence appears to depend on reviewer quality; and (4) information restriction raises cross-model F1 for the two lower tiers (+2.2 and +3.0pp) but not the top tier ( − 0.2 -0.2 pp; untested point estimates).
blocks.zh: 我们用补充来表示部分不重叠的检测,而不是超额外覆盖. (1) 补充检测:交叉模式审查(XMR)和CCR发现部分不同的缺陷(Jaccard 41.2%),CCR在代码上领先(F1 40.7%),文件上领先XMR(F1至42.1%);(2) 呼叫匹配覆盖:一个CCR+一个XMR审查与两个CCR审查的植入误差相匹配56.7%,而两个顶级XMR审查的增益并不显著;(3) 审查者能力似乎决定了效果——一个顶级审查者显示与CCR没有显著的区别,但一个轻量级模型的分数甚至低于基线的同文本审查,因此模型独立性的价值似乎取决于审查者的质量;(4) 信息限制为两个下层(+2.2和+3.0pp)提出了跨模式F1,但最高层(0.2-0.2页;未经测试的估计点)。

blocks.en: These results suggest tentative guidance: pairing a same-model review with a cross-model one gave more coverage than two same-model reviews, though not significantly more than two top-tier cross-model reviews; for resource-constrained settings, a single cross-model review with a top-tier reviewer had the highest F1 of any single condition in our data (not significantly above CCR); and lightweight cross-model reviewers offered no advantage over same-model review.
blocks.zh: 这些结果提出了初步指导:将同型审查与跨型审查合并,覆盖范围大于两个同型审查,尽管不超过两个顶级跨型审查;对于资源限制的设置,一个顶级审查员的单一跨型审查在我们的数据中具有任何单一条件中最高的F1(不明显高于CCR);轻量级跨型审查员比同一型审查没有优势.

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1 Context Independence
blocks.zh: 2.1 独立性

blocks.en: Cross-Context Review ( Song, 2026a , CCR;) conducts review in a fresh session, so the reviewer receives only the artifact, not the conversation that produced it. Across 360 sessions over 30 artifacts with 150 ground truth errors, the original report found CCR ahead of same-context review, testing run 1 alone (paired t t , p = 0.008 p=0.008 ); among the four same-model conditions, CCR ranks first in that run only (run-level F1 in Appendix D ). In the data used here, after excluding one same-context run of uncertain provenance (Section 4.1 ), CCR’s F1 is 28.6% versus 27.1%, and the artifact-level test finds no significant difference (unadjusted p = 0.26 p=0.26 ; Table 2 ). The original report attributed the gap to removing the conversational anchoring that biases a model toward defending its own output.
blocks.zh: 跨语录评论(宋, 2026a, CCR;)在一次新鲜的会话中进行审查,因此审查者只接收文物,而不是产生文物的谈话. 在超过30个有150个地面真相错误的文物中,最初的报告发现CCR领先于同文审查,测试单独运行1次(paired t t,p = 0.008 p = 0.008);在四个相同的模型条件中,CCR排在仅运行的第一位(运行级别F1在附录D中). 在此处使用的数据中,在排除了一个不确定出处的相同内容后(第4.1节),CCR的F1是28.6%,而27.1%,而文物水平测试发现没有显著差异(未调整的p=0.26 p=0.26;表2)。 最初的报告将这一差距归因于消除了对话的支柱,这种模式偏向于维护自己的产出。

blocks.en: 2.2 Temporal Independence
blocks.zh: 2.2 临时独立性

blocks.en: Diachronic CCR ( Song, 2026c , D-CCR;) tested repeated review rounds: counter-intuitively, a second round decreased performance, with false positives increasing by 62%. The report attributes this to the same model amplifying its existing false-confidence patterns rather than gaining new perspectives, which would suggest that repeating review in the same session is not a path to independence.
blocks.zh: Diachronic CCR (Song, 2026c, D-CCR;) 测试过重复审查回合:反直觉,第二轮表现下降,假阳性增长62%. 报告将这一点归因于同一模式,这种模式扩大了现有的虚假信心模式,而不是获得新的视角,这表明在同一届会议上重复审查并不是实现独立的途径。

blocks.en: 2.3 Structural Independence
blocks.zh: 2.3 结构独立

blocks.en: The HCCA report ( Song, 2026b ) assigns specialized analytical roles under intentional information restriction. In a pilot extending this to a multi-stage pipeline (worker, verifier, director) in which later stages could see earlier conclusions, the report observes only sycophantic confirmation and attributes the benefit of its main design to information restriction rather than to structural complexity.
blocks.zh: HCCA报告(Song, 2026b)在有意的信息限制下指定了专门的分析角色. 在一个将这一点推广到一个多阶段管道(工人、核查员、主任)的试点中,报告只注意到比较早的结论,并将其主要设计的好处归结为信息限制而不是结构复杂。

blocks.en: 2.4 The Remaining Dimension: Model Independence
blocks.zh: 2.4 (中文(简体) ). 剩余层面:模式独立

blocks.en: The three prior studies explored three ways of varying review within a single model : context can be reset, timing varied, and roles restructured, but the model’s training data, weights, and systematic biases remain constant. The natural next question is whether a different model, trained on different data with different objectives, provides a fundamentally different form of independence.
blocks.zh: 之前的三项研究探讨了在一个单一模式内进行不同审查的三种方式:可以重新设定背景、时间、角色重组,但模式的培训数据、权重和系统性偏差保持不变。 下一个自然的问题是,接受不同数据培训的具有不同目标的不同模型是否提供了一种根本不同的独立性形式。

blocks.en: Indirect evidence suggests it should. LLMs differ in measured capability across tasks ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Chiang et al., 2024 ) , and cross-model review has already been integrated into production developer tools ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . However, we are not aware of prior work that systematically measures whether these differences translate into complementary defect detection.
blocks.zh: 间接证据表明应该这样做。 LLMs在跨任务的测量能力上有所不同(郑等人,2023年;蒋等人,2024年),跨模型审查已经纳入生产开发工具(OpenAI,2026年). 然而,我们不知道以前曾进行过哪些工作来系统地衡量这些差异是否转化为补充性的缺陷检测。

blocks.en: 2.5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2.5 相关工作

blocks.en: LLM self-correction and self-preference. In-context self-correction without external feedback degrades accuracy ( Huang et al., 2024 ) ; Kamoi et al. (2024b) attribute the failure to the feedback (error-detection) stage and recommend analysing the quality of generated feedback directly. They also note that cross-model correction is unsuitable for testing whether a model can improve its own responses, and recommend comparisons against baselines of comparable computational cost; our two-review-call analysis matches the number of review calls, not compute. LLMs also favor their own generations ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ) . Neither line compares a same-conversation reviewer against a fresh-context or different-model reviewer: the axis we vary.
blocks.zh: LLM自我修正和自我偏爱. 无外部反馈的内文自我校正会降解精度(黄等人,2024年);卡莫伊等人(2024年b)将失败归因于反馈(error-detection)阶段,并建议直接分析生成反馈的质量. 他们还指出,跨模型校正不适合测试一个模型是否能够改进自己的反应,并建议与可比计算成本的基线进行比较;我们的两次审查-呼吁分析与审查呼叫次数相符,而不是计算。 LLMs也喜欢自己的世代(Panickssery等人,2024年). 这两行都把同一个对话审查员比作新文本或不同模式的审查员:我们的轴线各不相同。

blocks.en: Sycophancy and evaluation bias. LLMs adjust outputs to match perceived user preferences ( Sharma et al., 2024 ) and, as judges, exhibit positional and other judgement biases ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 协同和评价偏差。 LLMS调整产出,以适应所认为的用户偏好(Sharma等人,2024年),以及作为法官,显示立场和其他判断偏差(Wang等人,2024年b; 陈等, 2024 ).

blocks.en: Multi-agent systems and LLM-as-judge. Multi-agent frameworks structure multiple LLM instances to debate answers or assume specialized roles ( Du et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) , while LLM-as-judge approaches use LLMs to score or rank outputs ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) . These systems primarily manipulate structural and context independence but typically use a single underlying model, leaving model independence unexplored. Error-detection benchmarks: ReaLMistake ( Kamoi et al., 2024a ) and BIG-Bench Mistake ( Tyen et al., 2024 ) report low detection rates even for strong models, and CriticBench ( Lin et al., 2024 ) finds that stronger models critique weaker ones better while weaker models can sometimes surpass stronger ones in self-critique; but none of these analyses is organised around a model inspecting its own output versus another model’s.
blocks.zh: 多代理系统和LLM现职法官。 多剂框架结构了多个LLM实例来辩论答案或承担专门作用(Du等人,2024年;Liang等人,2024年;Chan等人,2024年;Hong等人,2024年;Qian等人,2024年),而LLM-as-judge的方法则使用LLMs来评分或排名产出(Zheng等人,2023年;Li等人,2024年;Kim等人,2024年). 这些系统主要操纵结构和上下文独立,但通常使用单一的基础模型,使模型独立得不到探讨. 错误检测基准 : ReaLMistake(Kamoi等人,2024a)和BIG-Bench Mistake(Tyen等人,2024年)报告说,即使是强型模型的检测率也很低,Critic Bench(Lin等人,2024年)发现,强型模型对弱型模型的批评更好,而弱型模型有时会超越强型模型的自我批评;但这些分析都不是围绕一个模型来组织的,该模型检查其自身的输出,而另一个模型的输出。

blocks.en: Software review and blind spots. LLMs are increasingly applied to code review ( Li et al., 2022 ; Pornprasit and Tantithamthavorn, 2024 ; Cihan et al., 2025 ) ; in a related setting, Shin et al. (2025) find that LLM-generated reviews of research papers over-focus on technical validity and overlook novelty compared with human experts. Doddapaneni et al. (2024) probe five evaluator LLMs with 2,400 perturbed answers and report that they miss quality drops in over 50% of cases on average. We use “blind spot” in a narrower sense (defects one reviewer model misses and another catches) and quantify it through Jaccard overlap.
blocks.zh: 软件审查和盲点。 法学硕士学位越来越多地应用于代码审查(Li等人,2022年;Pornprasit和Tantithamthavorn,2024年;Cihan等人,2025年);在相关的环境下,Shin等人(2025年)发现法学硕士研究论文的评审过于注重技术有效性,忽视了与人类专家相比的新颖性。 Doddapaneni等人(2024年)调查了5名评价员的LLMs,得到2,400个扰动的答案,并报告说,平均50%以上的病例没有达到质量下降。 我们使用狭义的“盲点”(影响一个审查员模型缺失和另一个渔获量),并通过Jaccard重叠加以量化。

blocks.en: Hallucination detection, ensembles, and N-version. Consistency-based methods exploit the intuition that disagreement across independent samples signals unreliability, via semantic entropy ( Farquhar et al., 2024 ) or reference checking ( Manakul et al., 2023 ) . Ensemble and mixture-of-agents methods show that model diversity improves aggregate performance ( Dietterich, 2000 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Tekin et al., 2024 ) , echoing N-version programming ( Chen and Avizienis, 1978 ) ; we extend these principles to across-model defect detection.
blocks.zh: 幻觉检测,综艺,和N版. 以一致性为基础的方法利用直觉,即独立样本之间的分歧通过语义上的肽(Farquhar等人,2024年)或参考物检查(Manakul等人,2023年)表明不可靠。 组合和混合剂方法表明,模型多样性能改善总体性能(Dietrich,2000年;Wang等人,2024年a;Tekin等人,2024年),与N版编程(Chen and Avizienis,1978年)相呼应;我们将这些原则扩展到跨模型缺陷检测。

blocks.en: Correlated errors and frontier blind spots. Kim et al. (2025) analyze over 350 LLMs, largely on multiple-choice benchmarks; on one leaderboard (HELM), pairs of models that both err choose the same wrong answer about 60% of the time, and larger, more accurate models have more highly correlated errors. This result raises concerns about naive multi-model ensembles and motivates our measurement of pairwise finding overlap (52.2% within the same model vs. 37–46% across models; Section 5.3 ), a descriptive comparison rather than a test of error correlation.
blocks.zh: 相关错误和边缘盲点。 金 al等. (2025年)分析超过350个LLM,主要使用多选择的基准;在一个导板(HELM)上,双错选择了大约60%时间相同的错误答案的对模型,更大的,更准确的模型有更高度关联的错误. 这一结果引起了对天真多模式组合的担忧,并激励我们衡量双向发现重叠(同一模式中的52.2%对模型中的37-46%;第5.3节),这是一种描述性比较,而不是对误差相关性的测试。

blocks.en: 3 A Framework for Independence in LLM Verification
blocks.zh: 3 《LLM核查独立框架》

blocks.en: 3.1 Dimensions of Independence
blocks.zh: 3.1 独立性的各个方面

blocks.en: We define four binary dimensions characterizing the relationship between a generator LLM (which produces the artifact) and a reviewer LLM (which verifies it):
blocks.zh: 我们定义了四个二进制维度,

blocks.en: Context independence (C): the reviewer has no access to the generation conversation, operating with P ⁡ ( findings ∣ artifact ) P(\text{findings}\mid\text{artifact}) rather than P ⁡ ( findings ∣ artifact , G ) P(\text{findings}\mid\text{artifact},G) , where G G is the generation transcript.
blocks.zh: 背景独立性(C):审查者无法接触世代对话, P(\texts{ findings}}}}\ mid\ text{ artifact}) 而不是 P {(发现 } 文物 , G ) P(\texts{ findings}}\ mid\ text}, G), 其中 G G 是生成的文本 。

blocks.en: Temporal independence (T): the review occurs in a single pass, with no memory of prior review rounds on the same artifact.
blocks.zh: 时间独立性(T):审查是一次性的,在同一件文物上没有前几轮审查的记忆。

blocks.en: Structural independence (S): the reviewer operates without hierarchical subordination to the generator, avoiding deference or sycophancy.
blocks.zh: 结构独立(S):审查者在操作时不对生成者进行等级从属,避免屈从或节制.

blocks.en: Model independence (M): the reviewer is a different model, typically from a different developer. This does not guarantee different training data or uncorrelated errors; whether cross-model errors are less correlated is an empirical question (Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 模型独立(M):审查者是一个不同的模型,一般来自不同的开发者. 这并不能保证不同的培训数据或无关错误;跨模型错误是否关联较少是一个经验问题(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: We additionally define information restriction (R) as a cross-cutting modifier: the reviewer receives only the artifact, without the original prompt or requirements, forcing assessment on intrinsic merits rather than compliance with stated goals.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步将信息限制(R)定义为一个跨领域的修饰者:审查者只接收文物,没有最初的及时性或要求,强迫根据内在优点而不是遵守既定目标进行评估。

blocks.en: 3.2 Experimental Conditions as Dimension Combinations
blocks.zh: 3.2 实验条件作为维度组合

blocks.en: Our 10 conditions map onto the framework as shown in Table 1 . All XMR conditions inherently include context independence, because in our design the cross-model reviewer never receives the generation conversation; comparing CCR (C only) against XMR conditions (C + M) therefore estimates the effect of replacing the reviewer model, which also changes reviewer capability and other model characteristics, rather than an isolated effect of model independence.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,我们10个条件已映射到框架。 所有XMR条件内在包括上下文独立,因为在我们的设计中跨模型审查者从未收到生成对话;因此将CCR(只有C)与XMR条件(C + M)进行比较,估计替换审查者模型的效果,这也改变了审查者的能力和其他模型特性,而不是模型独立的孤立效果.

blocks.en: Table 1: Experimental conditions mapped to independence dimensions. Temporal (T) and structural (S) dimensions are held constant across most conditions; SR2 uniquely lacks temporal independence (repeated review), and SA uniquely varies structural independence (sub-agent role). See Sections 2.2–2.3 for detailed analysis of these dimensions.
blocks.zh: 表1:按独立维度绘制的实验条件。 时间(T)和结构(S)维度在大多数条件下保持不变;SR2独有缺乏时间独立性(重复审查),SA独有不同结构独立性(副代理角色). 关于这些维度的详细分析,见第2.2至2.3节。

blocks.en: 3.3 Hypotheses
blocks.zh: 3.3 假设

blocks.en: Based on our framework, we test the following hypotheses:
blocks.zh: 根据我们的框架,我们测试以下假设:

blocks.en: H1 (Unique Finding). Cross-model review discovers defects that cross-context review misses, and vice versa. Formally: UFR ​ ( XMR → CCR ) > 0 \text{UFR}(\text{XMR}\to\text{CCR})>0 and UFR ​ ( CCR → XMR ) > 0 \text{UFR}(\text{CCR}\to\text{XMR})>0 , where UFR ​ ( A → B ) \text{UFR}(A\to B) is the proportion of A A ’s true positives not found by B B .
blocks.zh: H1 (独家搜索). 跨模式审查发现存在跨文本审查缺失的缺陷,反之亦然. 形式:UFR(XMR → CCR) > 0\text{UFR}(\text →MR}\to\text{CCR})>0和UFR(CCR → XMR)>0\text{UFR}(\text{CCR}\to\text{XMR})>0,其中UFR(A_B)\text{UFR}(A\to B)是B没有发现的A真实阳性值的比例.

blocks.en: H2 (Union Superiority). The union of CCR and XMR findings achieves higher recall than either alone (implied by H1 under a fixed matcher; we report it for its magnitude). Formally: Recall ​ ( CCR ∪ XMR ) > max ⁡ ( Recall ​ ( CCR ) , Recall ​ ( XMR ) ) \text{Recall}(\text{CCR}\cup\text{XMR})>\max(\text{Recall}(\text{CCR}),\text{Recall}(\text{XMR})) .
blocks.zh: H2(联合高级). CCR和XMR调查结果的结合比单独(H1在固定配对器下暗示;我们报告其规模)更能召回。 正式名称: recall (CCR QXMR) > max QQ ( recall (CCR), recall (XMR))\text{ recall} (\text{CCR}\cup\text{XMR})\max (\text{ recall} (\text{CCR}),\text{ recall} (\text{XMR})).

blocks.en: H3 (Bias Orthogonality). The overlap between CCR and XMR findings is lower than the overlap between independent sessions within the same model, which would be consistent with systematically different blind spots. Formally: Jaccard ​ ( CCR , XMR ) < Jaccard ​ ( CCR A , CCR B ) \text{Jaccard}(\text{CCR},\text{XMR})<\text{Jaccard}(\text{CCR}_{A},\text{CCR}_{B}) .
blocks.zh: H3(Bias Orthogonality) (英语). CCR和XMR调查结果的重叠程度低于同一模式内独立会话的重叠程度,这与系统不同的盲点是一致的. 形式:Jaccard(CCR,XMR) < Jaccard(CCR A,CCR B)\text{(\text{CCR},\text{MR})\text{Jacccard}(\text{CCR{A},\text{CCR{B}).

blocks.en: We additionally explore two non-directional hypotheses:
blocks.zh: 我们进一步探讨两个非定向假设:

blocks.en: H4 (Dimension Interaction). The combination of context and model independence exhibits interaction effects (synergistic or antagonistic) beyond the sum of individual effects. This hypothesis is not identifiable in our design, which has no condition with model independence but no context independence; we state it for completeness.
blocks.zh: H4(Dimension Interactive). 上下文和模型独立性的结合,显示出相互作用效应(协同效应或对立效应)超出单个效应的总和. 这一假设在我们的设计中是无法识别的,它没有模式独立的条件,也没有上下文独立;我们说它是完整的。

blocks.en: H5 (Error-Type Specialization). Different independence dimensions are differentially effective across error types (FACT, CONS, CTXT, RCVR, MISS) and artifact categories (code, document, script).
blocks.zh: H5 (Error-Type专业). 不同的独立维度在错误类型(FACT、CONS、CTXT、RCVR、MISS)和文物类别(代码、文档、脚本)之间具有不同的效力。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Experiment A: Controlled Code Review
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验A:受控码审查

blocks.en: Artifacts. We reuse the 30 software artifacts and 150 ground truth errors from Song (2026a) . The artifacts span three categories: code modules (C1–C10), technical tutorials (D1–D10), and presentation scripts (S1–S10). Each artifact contains 5 planted defects across 5 error types: factual errors (FACT), internal consistency violations (CONS), missing context handling (CTXT), recoverability gaps (RCVR), and missing functionality (MISS). Error severities range from Critical to Minor. Reusing identical artifacts enables direct comparison with prior results.
blocks.zh: 人工兽 [永久失效連結] 重用30个软件文物和宋时(2026a)的150个地面真相错误. 这些文物分为三类:代码模块(C1-C10)、技术教程(D1-D10)和演示文稿(S1-S10)。 每个文物中包含5种被埋设的缺陷,涉及5种错误类型:事实错误(FACT),内部一致性违反(CONS),缺失上下文处理(CTXT),可回收性缺口(RCVR),缺失功能(MISS). 错误断裂范围从关键到次要。 重新使用相同的文物可以直接与以前的结果进行比较。

blocks.en: Generator model. All 30 artifacts were generated by a single frontier-class LLM, Claude Opus 4.6 according to our run logs; the artifact files themselves do not record the generating model. The same-model baselines (SR, SR2, SA, CCR) were run with that model, subject to the same caveat. Reviewer model identifiers denote the requested API parameter rather than a confirmed served checkpoint, as the endpoints do not return a served model identifier. Using a single generator ensures that all reviewer conditions evaluate identical artifacts, removing generator variation; it does not separate reviewer independence from other reviewer characteristics such as capability.
blocks.zh: 发电机模型。 根据我们的运行日志,所有30件文物都是由一个单一的前沿级LLM(英语:Claude Opus 4.6)生成的;文物档案本身没有记录生成模型. 同一型号的基线(SR、SR2、SA、CCR)与该型号相同,但有同样的戒备。 审阅器模型标识符表示请求的API参数,而不是确认的已服务检查站,因为端点不返回已服务模型标识符. 使用单一的生成器可确保所有审查者的条件评价相同的文物,消除生成器的变异;它不会将审查者的独立性与能力等其他审查者特征区分开来.

blocks.en: Dependence on prior work. The four baseline conditions (SR, SR2, SA, CCR), the C/T/S dimensions, and the artifacts with their ground truth come from the earlier preprints; only the XMR conditions and the unifying taxonomy are new. Appendix A specifies the artifacts, error injection, and matching so that the claims here can be checked without those reports. The baselines were collected before the XMR conditions under the same protocol, a temporal asymmetry noted in Limitations.
blocks.zh: 依赖以前的工作。 四个基线条件(SR,SR2,SA,CCR),C/T/S维度,以及带有地面真伪的文物都来自早期的预印;只有XMR条件和统一分类是新的. 附 录 A指定了文物、错误注入和匹配,以便无需报告即可核对此处的索赔。 基线是在XMR条件之前根据同一协议收集的,限制中注意到时间不对称。

blocks.en: Data provenance and exclusions. We audited all 900 session records against the raw files before the analysis reported here. The 540 cross-model records carry the reviewer model identifier, call duration, and a per-session timestamp. The 360 same-model baseline sessions were run through the Claude Code agent tool and transcribed into structured files by the host session; they carry no raw model output, and in several runs all 30 files share one timestamp. For one run (SR, run 3), 92% of the finding descriptions appear verbatim inside the script that wrote the files, so we cannot confirm that they are unedited model output, and we exclude this run from all analyses. Fourteen cross-model sessions failed (five timeouts or crashes and nine unparseable outputs; eight of the fourteen were XMR-Ge-R sessions) and had been scored as reviews with no findings; because a failed call is not a review, we exclude them as well. The analyses therefore describe cross-model review when the call succeeds; Appendix D reports the main values with failures scored as zero. The exclusion rules followed from the audit and were fixed before the full recomputation, although a partial check of their effect on cross-model F1 was run during the audit. The remaining baseline records are unverified rather than known to be clean.
blocks.zh: 数据来源和排除。 在分析之前,我们对照原始文件 审核了900个会话记录 540个跨模式记录带有审查员模式识别符,调用期限,以及每会时间戳. 360同型的基准会话通过Claude Code代理工具运行,并由主机会话转录成结构化文件;它们没有原始模型输出,在几个会话中,所有30个文件都共享1倍标. 在一次运行(SR, run 3)中,92%的查找描述出现在撰写文件的脚本中,因此我们无法确认它们是未经编辑的模型输出,我们排除了所有分析中的这一运行. 14次跨模式会议失败(5次超时或崩溃,9次产出无法分割;14次会议中有8次是XMR-Ge-R会议),被评为审查,没有结果;由于一次失败的呼吁不是审查,我们也将其排除在外。 因此,这些分析描述了调用成功时的跨模型审查;附录D报告了故障得分为零的主要值。 排除规则是审计中遵循的,在完全重算之前已经确定,不过在审计期间对其对跨型号F1的影响进行了部分检查. 其余基线记录未经核实,而不是已知的干净。

blocks.en: Conditions and scale. We evaluate 10 conditions (Table 1 ), each with 90 sessions (3 runs per artifact × \times 30 artifacts), yielding 900 sessions total.
blocks.zh: 条件与规模. 我们评价10个条件(表1),每期90次(每件3次运行),共计900次。

blocks.en: Reviewer models. We employ three external reviewer models from two developers at different capability tiers. The tiers reflect the vendors’ positioning at the time of the experiment, not a capability we measured, and GPT-5.4 is also a later model generation than Gemini 2.5: • GPT-5.4 (top-tier): a model from a different developer than the generator. • Gemini 2.5 Pro (capable): a strong model from a third developer. • Gemini 2.5 Flash (lightweight): a cost-optimized model from the same developer as Gemini 2.5 Pro, testing whether model independence helps even with reduced capability.
blocks.zh: 评委模型. 我们使用来自两个不同能力级别的开发商的三种外部审查员模型。 阶梯反映了销售商在实验时的定位,而不是我们测得的能力,GPT-5.4也是比双子座2.5: → GPT-5.4(顶级):一个来自不同开发商的模型,而不是发电机. ^ 双子座2.5 Pro(能):来自第三开发商的强力模型. ^ 双子座2.5 Flash(轻量级):由双子座2.5 Pro同一开发商提供的成本优化模型,测试模型独立是否有助于即使能力下降.

blocks.en: GPT-5.4 (top-tier): a model from a different developer than the generator.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.4(顶级):来自不同开发者的模型,与生成器不同.

blocks.en: Gemini 2.5 Pro (capable): a strong model from a third developer.
blocks.zh: 双子座2.5 Pro(能):来自第三开发商的强模型.

blocks.en: Gemini 2.5 Flash (lightweight): a cost-optimized model from the same developer as Gemini 2.5 Pro, testing whether model independence helps even with reduced capability.
blocks.zh: 双子座2.5 Flash(轻量级):与双子座2.5 Pro相同的开发者的一种成本优化模型,测试模型独立是否有助于即使能力下降.

blocks.en: For each family, we test both unrestricted (full artifact + requirements) and information-restricted (artifact only) conditions.
blocks.zh: 对于每个家庭,我们检验不受限制(完整的文物+要求)和信息限制(只有艺术品)的条件。

blocks.en: Procedure. Each session proceeds identically: the reviewer receives the artifact (and requirements, unless information-restricted) and produces a structured list of findings (location, description, severity, error type). Findings are matched against the ground truth by location- and keyword-overlap scoring, each finding assigned to at most one ground-truth error and each ground-truth error credited at most once per review (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 2. 程序。 每场会议均以相同的方式进行:审查者接收文物(和要求,但信息受限制者除外),并产生一份结构化的调查结果清单(地点、说明、严重程度、错误类型)。 通过地点和关键词重叠评分,将结果与地面真相相匹配,每项结果最多分配到一个地面真相错误,每项审查最多记录一次地面真相错误(附录A)。

blocks.en: Statistical testing. We use the Wilcoxon signed-rank test for paired comparisons at the artifact level (averaging the available runs per artifact per condition after the exclusions of Section 4.1 ; every artifact keeps at least one run in every condition, so each test uses 30 paired observations), with Holm-Bonferroni correction over the nine comparisons against CCR. For comparison with the original CCR report, Table 2 also gives paired t t -tests on run 1 alone without correction; our conclusions use the former. Union analysis computes the unique ground truth errors detected by at least one session per condition, yielding Union Recall, Unique Finding Rate (UFR), and Jaccard similarity.
blocks.zh: 统计测试。 我们使用Wilcoxon的签名排名测试来进行文物层面的配对比较(在第4.1节排除后,每个文物每个条件的可用运行情况进行;每个文物每个条件至少保持一个运行情况,所以每个测试都使用30对观测结果),Holm-Bonferroni对9对CCR的比对进行校正. 与最初的CCR报告相比,表2还给出了单次运行1上的配对 t - t测试,没有更正;我们的结论采用了前者. 联盟分析计算每个条件至少有一个会话检测到的独特的地面真伪错误,得出联盟召回率(UFR),独特查找率(UFR)和雅克卡尔相似性.

blocks.en: 4.2 Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 4.2 可复制

blocks.en: The artifacts, ground-truth annotations, review prompts, per-session review records, and analysis scripts are available from the author on request. Raw API outputs and per-session model identifiers exist only for the cross-model conditions; the same-model baseline records were transcribed into structured files by the host session and do not include raw model output (Section 4.1 ). We note that exact reproduction is limited by the non-deterministic nature of LLM outputs, and the 90 sessions per condition are repeated measurements on 30 artifacts, so our tests use 30 artifact-level pairs.
blocks.zh: 文物、地面真相说明、审查提示、每届会议审查记录和分析脚本可向作者索取。 原始的API输出和每会场模型标识符仅针对跨模型条件存在;同一模型基线记录由主机会话转录为结构化文件,不包括原始模型输出(第4.1节). 我们注意到,准确的复制受到LLM输出的非定型性质的限制,每个条件的90场都是对30件文物的反复测量,因此我们的测试使用30件文物级对.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 5.1 总体业绩

blocks.en: Table 2 presents the main results across all 10 conditions, ranked by F1 score, and Figure 2 (Appendix) visualizes this ranking.
blocks.zh: 表2列出所有10个条件的主要结果,按F1分数排名,图2(附录)可视化这一排名.

Values are percentages. p W p_{\mathrm{W}} : Wilcoxon signed-rank test against CCR on per-artifact means over the available runs, Holm-adjusted over nine comparisons (only SR2 differs); p t p_{t} : paired t t -test on run 1 only, unadjusted, as in the original CCR report.
blocks.zh: 表2: 10个条件的绩效(900场次;n = 不包括SR运行3和14个失败的跨模式会话后分析的会话,第4.1节;附录D给出的失败得分为零的值). 数值为百分比。 p W _{\ mathrm{W}} }}:Wilcoxon针对 CCR 的签名排名测试,在可用运行中每端表示,Holm 调整比9个比较(只有 SR2 不同);p t _{ t_{ t} t - - 仅在运行1上进行配对,未调整,如最初的 CCR 报告.

blocks.en: The top three conditions are all cross-model configurations, and the bottom three are the lightweight cross-model condition (XMR-Ge), the sub-agent baseline (SA), and the repeated baseline (SR2). XMR-Ge-R (27.0%) is level with SR (27.1%), so model independence with a lightweight reviewer shows no clear advantage over baseline self-review.
blocks.zh: 前3个条件均为跨型构型,下3个条件为轻量级跨型条件(XMR-Ge),副剂基线(SA),重复基线(SR2). XMR-Ge-R(27.0%)与SR(27.1%)是水平的,因此配有轻量级审查器的模型独立显示比基线自评没有明显的优势.

blocks.en: The difference between the best XMR condition (XMR-GPT, 32.3%) and CCR (28.6%) is not statistically significant (adjusted p W = 1.00 p_{\mathrm{W}}=1.00 ; run-1 p t = 0.478 p_{t}=0.478 ). We therefore detect no F1 difference between model independence with a top-tier reviewer and context independence alone; without an equivalence test, this is not evidence that the two are equal.
blocks.zh: 最佳XMR条件(XMR-GPT,32.3%)和CCR(28.6%)之间的差别在统计学上并不显著(调整p W = 1.00 p_{\mathrm{W}}=1.00;运行-1 p t = 0.478 p_{t}=0.478),因此我们检测到只有顶级审查员的模型独立性和仅上下文独立性的F1差异;没有等效测试,这并不能证明两者是平等的.

blocks.en: The spread across reviewer models is larger. XMR-GPT (32.3%) exceeds XMR-Ge (24.0%) by 8.3 percentage points, more than the gap between CCR and SR (1.5pp). This single comparison is outside the nine-comparison family; its unadjusted Wilcoxon p p is 0.020 with failed sessions excluded and 0.071 with them scored as zero, and it would not survive correction if added to the family. The data are consistent with reviewer capability mattering more than independence per se, but do not establish it.
blocks.zh: 跨评论员模式的分布较大. XMR-GPT(32.3%)超过XMR-Ge(24.0%)8.3个百分点,超过CCR和SR(1.5pp)的差距. 此单比在九比家族之外;其未调整的Wilcoxon pp为0.020,不包括失败的会话,0.071与他们的得分为零,如果加入家族,它不会幸存的校正. 数据与审查者的能力一致,与其说是独立性,不如说是独立性本身,但不能证明这一点。

blocks.en: 5.2 Complementary Detection (H1, H2)
blocks.zh: 5.2 辅助探测(H1,H2)

blocks.en: While individual F1 scores are similar between CCR and top XMR conditions, their coverage patterns differ meaningfully.
blocks.zh: 虽然个人F1分数在CCR和顶级XMR条件之间相似,但其覆盖模式却存在有意义的差异.

blocks.en: Union Recall (Figure 1 ): under the existing automated matcher, a two-review-call comparison yields 85/150 (56.7%) matched ground-truth errors for one CCR plus one XMR-GPT-R review versus 64/150 (42.7%) for two CCR reviews, a 14.0pp gain (artifact-level bootstrap 95% CI [6.7, 22.0]; signed-rank p = .006 p=.006 , Holm-adjusted over the three union comparisons). These are set-level recalls over run 1 (singles 56 and 64; 56 + 64 − 35 = 85 56+64-35=85 ), not the per-session means of Table 2 . Across the three runs per condition, mixed unions cover 44.7–56.7% and CCR-only unions 30.0–42.7% (reused runs, not independent replications). Against two XMR-GPT-R reviews, on the 29 artifacts without a failed session (76/145 vs. 82/145 for the mixed pair), the gain is 4.1pp (95% CI [ − 2.1 -2.1 , 10.3]; adjusted p = .184 p=.184 ). The third comparison in the family uses self-review as the same-model partner: SR plus XMR-GPT-R matches 77/150 against 53/150 for SR plus SR2 in run 1 (+16.0pp, 95% CI [6.7, 26.0]; adjusted p = .008 p=.008 ). These retrospective results are conditional on the matcher; condition-specific matching bias remains unmeasured.
blocks.zh: 联合召回(图1):在现有自动比对器下,两次审查-召回的比对结果为85/150(56.7%),比对一次CCR加上一次XMR-GPT-R审查的地面事实错误,对两次CCR审查的比对结果为64/150(42.7%),收益为14.0pp(工艺级靴套:95%CI [6.7,22.0];签名-恶作剧p=.006 p=.006,对三次工会比较作了调整)。 这些是运行1(56和64;56 + 64 − 35 = 85 56+64-35 = 85),而不是表2的每期手段。 混合工会在每期的三期中占44.7-56.7%,只有CCR的工会占30.0-42.7%(重复使用,而不是独立推广)。 对照两次XMR-GPT-R评论,关于29件没有失败的文物(76/145 vs. 82/145 混合配对),收益为4.1pp(95% CI [−2.1-2.1, 10.3];调整后的p=184 p=184. 家庭的第三次比较使用自我审查作为同型伴侣:SR加XMR-GPT-R比对运行1中的SR加SR2的53/150比77/150(+16.0pp,95%CI [6.7,26.0];调整后的p=.008 p=.008). 这些追溯结果以匹配者为条件;针对具体条件的匹配偏差仍未计量.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Planted errors matched by CCR and by XMR-GPT-R (run 1 of each condition; 150 errors in total).
blocks.zh: 图1:由CCR和XMR-GPT-R(每个条件运行1;共运行150个错误)相匹配的布局错误.

blocks.en: The Jaccard similarity between CCR and XMR-GPT-R is 41.2% (35 of 85 unique errors found by either), indicating moderate overlap: the approaches share a substantial core, but ∼ \sim 59% of unique findings come from only one approach, supporting H1 (each finds defects the other misses). The 14.0pp union gain is consistent with H2 (union superiority) in the narrow sense that the union covers more than either review alone. Any two imperfect, non-identical detectors raise union recall mechanically; the observed unions in fact fall below both pooled and within-artifact independence reference values ( r A + r B − r A ​ r B r_{A}+r_{B}-r_{A}r_{B} ). These descriptive comparisons do not establish synergy or its absence; we do not claim synergy (super-additive coverage beyond independent expectation)—complementarity here refers to non-overlap (Jaccard 41.2%).
blocks.zh: CCR和XMR-GPT-R之间的Jaccard相似度为41.2%(两者中任何一个发现的85个独特错误中的35个),表示有中等程度的重叠:这些方法有一个实质性的核心,但59%的独特结果只来自一种方法,支持H1(每个方法发现缺陷,而另一个则缺失)。 14.0pp工会收益与H2(工会优越性)一致,狭义上,工会涵盖的不仅仅是审查。 任何两种不完美的、非相同的探测器都会机械地提高工会召回率;观察到的工会实际上都低于集合式和艺术内独立参考值(r A + r B → r B → r → r → r → r → r → B ) 。 这些描述性比较并不能确定协同效应或缺乏协同效应;我们并不声称协同效应(超出独立预期的超额外覆盖)――此处的互补性是指非重叠效应(Jaccar 41.2%)。

blocks.en: 5.3 Bias Orthogonality (H3)
blocks.zh: 5.3 偏执性(H3)

blocks.en: To test whether cross-model overlap is lower than within-model overlap (which would be consistent with systematically different blind spots), we computed pairwise Jaccard similarity at the finding level across all run pairs.
blocks.zh: 为了测试跨模型重叠是否低于模型内部重叠(这与系统不同的盲点是一致的),我们计算了所有运行对子在查找层面的双智Jaccard相似性。

blocks.en: Within-condition overlap (same model, different sessions): CCR 52.2% (90 run pairs), SR 61.8% (30 pairs, runs 1–2 only), XMR-GPT 59.3% (84), XMR-Ge 55.1% (88). Cross-condition overlap (all run combinations): CCR vs. XMR-GPT 46.1% (258 pairs), CCR vs. XMR-Ge 36.5% (267), and CCR vs. SR 59.9% (180; same model, different context). Pairs involving an excluded session are dropped, so the pair counts differ.
blocks.zh: 条件内重叠(同型,不同会话):CCR52.2%(90对运行),SR61.8%(30对运行,仅运行1–2),XMR-GPT59.3%(84),XMR-Ge55.1%(88). 交叉条件重叠(所有运行组合):CCR vs. XMR-GPT 46.1% (258对),CCR vs. XMR-Ge 36.5% (267),CCR vs. SR 59.9% (180;同型,上下文不同). 涉及被排除在外的会话的对价被取消,所以对数不同。

blocks.en: Within-model session pairs share 52–62% of findings, while cross-model pairs share 37–46%. The difference between CCR intra-condition overlap (52.2%) and CCR-vs-XMR cross-model overlap (average 41.3%) is 10.9 percentage points, consistent with H3. Lower overlap can also arise from differences in detection rates or finding counts, and the run pairs share artifacts, so this is descriptive support rather than a test.
blocks.zh: 模式内对接共享52-62%的发现,而跨模式对接共享37-46%. CCR在条件内重叠(52.2%)和CCR-vs-XMR跨型重叠(平均41.3%)的差别为10.9个百分点,与H3一致. 更低的重叠也可能产生于检测率或发现计数的差异,运行对子共享文物,所以这是描述性支持而不是测试.

blocks.en: CCR vs. SR overlap (59.9%) is comparable to within-condition overlaps: we see no clear sign that changing the context alone changes which errors the model finds, whereas changing the model is accompanied by lower overlap, which matters given that high-capability LLMs exhibit strongly correlated errors ( Kim et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: CCR vs. SR 重叠(59.9%)与条件内重叠相当:我们没有看到明确的迹象表明,仅改变上下文就改变了模型发现的错误,而改变模型则伴随着较低的重叠,这很重要,因为能力高的LLMs 显示出了强烈相关的错误(Kim等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: 5.4 Domain Specialization (H5)
blocks.zh: 5.4 领域专门化(H5)

blocks.en: The aggregate F1 scores mask a reversal at the category level (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: F1总分掩盖了类别级的逆转(表3).

blocks.en: Table 3: F1 (%) by artifact category. Bold indicates best condition per category.
blocks.zh: 表3:按文物类别分列的F1 (%). 粗体表示每个类别的最佳条件。

blocks.en: For code artifacts, CCR outperforms all XMR conditions; one possible explanation is that the generating model shares an understanding of programming patterns and code structure that an external model lacks. For documents, the pattern reverses, and it holds for every condition, not only those in the table: all six cross-model conditions (F1 30.1–42.1%) score above all four same-model conditions (17.4–24.5%). XMR conditions perform better, suggesting a different model brings different expectations about consistency and completeness, shaped by different training corpora. This category reversal is our clearest descriptive support for H5, although the category estimates carry no uncertainty intervals and the explanations above are conjectures; it suggests that the choice between CCR and XMR should depend on artifact type.
blocks.zh: 对于代码文物,CCR超越了所有XMR条件;一种可能的解释是生成模型共享对外部模型缺乏的编程模式和代码结构的理解. 对于文档来说,模式倒转,并且每个条件都坚持,不仅仅是表中的条件:所有6个跨模式条件(F1 30.1-42.1%)都高于所有4个相同的模式条件(17.4-24.5%)。 XMR条件表现较好,建议不同的模式对一致性和完整性带来不同的期望,由不同的训练团塑造. 这一类别倒置是我们对H5的最明确的描述性支持,尽管类别估计没有不确定性间隔,上面的解释是推测的;这表明CCR和XMR之间的选择应该取决于文物类型.

blocks.en: 5.5 Error Type Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.5 错误类型分析

blocks.en: Breaking down results by error type reveals further specialization (Table 4 ). Detection rates are per-session recall for each error type, averaged over the analysed sessions ( n n as in Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 按错误类型分列结果显示进一步专业化(表4)。 检测率是每个错误类型的每次召回,按分析的会话平均计算(n如表2所示)。

blocks.en: Table 4: Detection rate (%) by error type (recall per type). Bold indicates best condition per type.
blocks.zh: 表4:按错误类型(每类召回)分列的检测率(%)。 粗体表示每种类型的最佳条件。

blocks.en: Several patterns emerge. The top-tier cross-model reviewer is higher than CCR on FACT (58% vs. 48%) and CONS (53% vs. 37%). On CTXT, where operational context matters, the two top-tier conditions reach 26–31%, against 9–18% for every other condition (XMR-GPT-R and SR are not shown in the table). Across all six cross-model conditions (including three not shown in Table 4 ), RCVR varies most (7–38%), followed by FACT (35–58%) and CTXT (9–31%), consistent with these types being sensitive to reviewer capability.
blocks.zh: 出现了几种模式。 在FACT(58%对48%)和CONS(53%对37%)上,顶级跨模式审查员高于CCR. 在CTXT,在操作环境很重要的情况下,两个顶级条件达到26-31%,而其他条件为9-18 %(表没有显示XMR-GPT-R和SR)。 在所有六种跨模式条件(包括表4未列出的三个条件)中,RCVR差异最大(7-38%),其次是FACT(35-58%)和CTXT(9-31%),这与这些类型对审查者能力敏感一致。

blocks.en: The apparent tension between Tables 3 and 4 , namely CCR’s higher F1 on code (40.7% vs. 37.2%) despite XMR-GPT’s comparable or higher per-type recall, is consistent with precision: on code, CCR’s precision is 46.9% versus 35.6% for XMR-GPT, while its recall is 36.7% versus 40.0%. The analyses also operate at different granularities, so dominance at one level need not imply it at the other.
blocks.zh: 尽管XMR-GPT的每类召回率相当或更高,但表3和表4之间的明显矛盾,即CCR在代码上较高的F1(40.7%对37.2%)与精确一致:在代码上,CCR的精确度是46.9%对XMR-GPT的35.6%,而其召回率为36.7%对40.0%。 这些分析也在不同颗粒区进行,因此,在某一层次的支配地位不一定意味着在另一层次的支配地位。

blocks.en: 5.6 Information Restriction Effect
blocks.zh: 5.6 信息限制效应

blocks.en: Restricting the information available to the reviewer, by providing only the artifact without the original requirements, changes cross-model F1 by tier as follows: top-tier 32.3 → \to 32.1 ( − 0.2 -0.2 ), capable 26.8 → \to 29.0 (+2.2), and lightweight 24.0 → \to 27.0 (+3.0). The two sides of each comparison are not the same session sets after exclusions, and with failed sessions scored as zero the changes are +0.9, +2.2, and +0.9 (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 限制审查者可得到的信息,只提供没有原要求的文物,将跨型F1按等级修改如下:顶级32.3~~~~~到32.1(−0.2~0.2),能26.8~~~~29.0(+2.2),轻重量24.0~~~~到27.0(+3.0). 每次比较的两面不是排除后相同的会话设置,如果失败的会话得分为零,则变化为+0.9,+2.2和+0.9(附录D )。

blocks.en: This pattern is consistent with the earlier HCCA report ( Song, 2026b ) that less information promotes more independent judgment; the per-tier gains are untested point estimates, and the account that follows is a hypothesis. When the reviewer cannot simply check the artifact against stated requirements, it must assess the artifact on its intrinsic quality, detecting inconsistencies, logical gaps, and errors that requirement-checking might overlook. After the exclusions the top-tier reviewer shows no gain (+0.9 with failures scored as zero), and the size of the lightweight tier’s gain depends on how failed sessions are handled, so the relationship between reviewer capability and the benefit of restriction is unclear.
blocks.zh: 这种模式与早先的HCCA报告(Song, 2026b)一致,认为信息较少有利于更独立的判断;每层收益是未经测试的点估计,下面的账户是一个假设. 当审查人员不能简单地对照所述要求检查文物时,它必须评估文物的内在质量,发现不一致之处、逻辑缺陷和可能忽略的要求检查错误。 在排除后,顶级审查者显示没有收益(+0.9,失败得分为零),轻量级收益的大小取决于如何处理失败的会话,所以审查者能力与限制的好处之间的关系并不明确.

blocks.en: 5.7 Reviewer Model Capability
blocks.zh: 5.7 审查员示范能力

blocks.en: Within each restriction setting, F1 increases with reviewer tier: top-tier 32.1–32.3% (above CCR’s 28.6%, not significantly), capable 26.8–29.0% (approaching CCR with restriction), and lightweight 24.0–27.0% (at or below the SR baseline of 27.1%). The spread between the best and worst XMR conditions (8.3pp) is larger than the total spread among all same-model conditions (6.9pp), although ranges over different sets of conditions are not directly comparable effect sizes.
blocks.zh: 在每个限制设置中,F1随着审查者的级别而增加:顶级32.1-32.3%(高于CCR的28.6%,并不显著),能达到26.8-29.0%(采用有限制的CCR),轻量级24.0-27.0%(在斯洛伐克共和国基线27.1%以下)。 最佳和最差的XMR条件(8.3pp)之间的差幅大于所有相同模型条件(6.9pp)之间的总差幅,尽管不同条件组之间的差幅并非直接可比效果大小.

blocks.en: 5.8 Model Bias False Positives
blocks.zh: 5.8 典型偏见假阳性

blocks.en: Cross-model review introduces a new category of false positive: model bias errors, where the reviewer flags issues based on its own training data rather than actual defects. Classifying all XMR false positives via keyword-based analysis, 187 of 1,995 (9.4%) were model bias; the most common subcategory (72.7%, 136/187) involved flagging generator-specific features or tools as non-existent, which may reflect differences in training data between model families (the classification is keyword-based and was not validated). Information restriction partially mitigates this (lightweight 13% → \to 10%, capable 10% → \to 8%), and the top-tier model shows the lowest rate (9% unrestricted, 8% restricted).
blocks.zh: 跨模型审查引入了一个新的假阳性类别:模型偏差错误,其中审查者会根据自己的训练数据而不是实际缺陷发布. 将所有XMR假阳性通过关键词分析分类,1,995个(9.4%)中的187个是模型偏差;最常见的亚类(72.7%,136/187)涉及标注生成器特定特征或工具不存在,这可能反映了模型家族之间培训数据的差异(分类基于关键词,未经验证). 信息限制部分缓解了这种情况(轻度13%~~~~10%,能力10%~~8%),顶级模式显示最低(9%不受限制,8%受限制).

blocks.zh: 5.9 案例研究

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 Why Different Models Find Different Things
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 为什么不同的模型会发现不同的 东西

blocks.en: The partial non-overlap is consistent with several explanations, though our design does not establish causal mechanisms: training-data divergence (different corpora, different standards), different capability profiles (the category reversal suggests code review benefits from shared programming context, document review from diverse perspectives), and model-specific knowledge gaps (cross-model reviewers also flag non-errors from their own gaps; Section 5.8 ).
blocks.zh: 部分不重叠与若干解释是一致的,尽管我们的设计没有建立因果机制:培训-数据差异(不同的公司、不同的标准)、不同的能力简介(类别倒置表明代码审查得益于共同的方案拟订背景,从不同角度对文件进行审查)和具体模式的知识差距(跨模式审查员还从自己的差距中标出非侵权者;第5.8节)。

blocks.en: Kim et al. (2025) find strongly correlated errors on closed-ended benchmarks; our unions also fall below the independence reference (Section 5.2 ), so the partial non-overlap we observe should not be read as independent errors. Perspective diversification (B5) and three-model unions are discussed in Appendix E.1 .
blocks.zh: 金 al等. (2025年)在封闭式基准上发现紧密相关的错误;我们的工会也低于独立参考(第5.2节),因此我们观察到的部分不重叠不应被理解为独立错误. 附录E.1讨论了观点多样化(B5)和三种模式的结合。

blocks.en: 6.2 Practical Guidelines
blocks.zh: 6.2 实用准则

blocks.en: Based on our findings, we offer the following tentative guidance, limited to this sample of artifacts and reviewers. For maximum coverage, combine same-model and cross-model review (56.7% vs. 42.7% for two same-model reviews at the same number of review calls; not significantly above two top-tier cross-model reviews). For a single best approach, use cross-model review with a top-tier reviewer (F1 32.1–32.3%; not significantly above CCR) at single-review cost. Prioritize same-model review for code-heavy projects (F1 40.7% vs. 37.2% on code) and cross-model review for documentation/consistency (F1 42.1% vs. 24.5% on documents); avoid cross-model review with lightweight models (F1 24.0–27.0% vs. CCR 28.6%).
blocks.zh: 根据我们的调查结果,我们提出以下暂定指导,仅限于这些文物样本和审查者。 对于最大覆盖范围,结合同型和跨型审查(56.7%对42.7%对相同数量的同型审查;不明显高于两个顶级跨型审查). 对于单一的最佳方法,使用具有顶级审查员(F1 32.1-32.3%;不明显高于CCR)的跨模式审查,采用单一审查费用. 优先对代码重度项目进行同型审查(F1 40.7%对37.2%),对文件/一致性进行跨型审查(F1 42.1%对24.5%对文件);避免使用轻量级模型进行跨型审查(F1 24.0-27.0%对28.6%)。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented a four-dimensional framework for independence in LLM verification and new experiments on model independence. Across 900 sessions, CCR leads on code and XMR on documents, and one CCR plus one XMR review covers more ground-truth errors than two CCR reviews (56.7% vs. 42.7%). Most other comparisons are descriptive; in our primary test, only SR2 differs significantly from CCR. A factorial design that varies generator, reviewer model, and context independently, and evaluation on established benchmarks such as FEVER ( Thorne et al., 2018 ) , AVeriTeC ( Schlichtkrull et al., 2023 ) , CUAD ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , or LegalBench ( Guha et al., 2023 ) , would test these patterns more directly.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了在LLM核查中实现独立的四维框架和关于模式独立性的新实验。 在900个课中,CCR领先于文件的代码和XMR,1个CCR+1个XMR审查覆盖的地面真相错误比2个CCR审查(56.7%对42.7%)多. 多数其他比较都是描述性的;在我们的主要测试中,只有SR2与CCR有很大的不同. 一种因子设计,不同生成器、审查器模型和上下文独立,以及对FEVER(Sorne等人,2018年),AVeriTeC等既定基准的评价 (Schlichtkrull等人,2023年),CUAD(Hendrycks等人,2021年),或Legal Bench(Guha等人,2023年),将更直接地检验这些模式.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Design. All artifacts came from a single generator, and each capability tier is represented by one reviewer model (three models from two developers), so reviewer capability and model identity are confounded. All cross-model conditions also include context independence, so H4 (an interaction between context and model independence) cannot be identified; a factorial design is left to future work.
blocks.zh: 设计. 所有文物都来自一个单一的生成器,每个能力级由一个审查员模型(来自两个开发者的3个模型)代表,因此审查员能力和模型身份都令人困惑. 所有跨模型条件也包括上下文独立,因此H4(上下文和模型独立之间的相互作用)无法识别;一个要素设计留待未来工作.

blocks.en: Data and measurement. The ground truth consists of planted errors written at injection time and was not independently annotated, and the matcher was not audited by hand. The same-model baselines reuse data collected before the cross-model conditions; their records cannot be checked against raw model output, and we treat them as unverified rather than clean (Section 4.1 ). The union comparison is retrospective: CCR runs differ widely (56, 37, and 29 matched errors), the headline pairing is among the higher of the reused run combinations, and whether the matcher treats the reviewers’ output styles equally is unmeasured. The per-error-type and per-category comparisons are descriptive and were not tested for significance.
blocks.zh: 数据和计量。 地面真实性由注射时写出的植入错误组成,没有独立附加说明,配对者也没有通过人工审核. 在跨模型条件之前收集的同型基线再利用数据;其记录不能与原始模型输出对照检查,我们将其视为未经核实而非干净(第4.1节)。 联盟比较具有追溯性:CCR运行差异很大(56,37和29个匹配错误 ) , 头条配对属于重用运行组合中较高的部分,配对者是否同等对待审查者的输出风格是没有测量的. 每类和每类的比较都是描述性的,没有经过重大测试。

blocks.en: Language. All artifacts and ground-truth annotations are in Korean, and review output language was not fixed across conditions: in run 1, 20 of 30 CCR reviews are in English while the other conditions’ reviews are mostly in Korean. Because the matcher’s keyword component compares findings with Korean ground-truth text (Appendix A ), it may under-credit English-language reviews. Other languages are untested.
blocks.zh: 语言. 所有文物和地面真实说明都用韩语,审查产出语言没有在各种条件下固定下来:在运行中,30份CCR评论中有20份用英文,而其他条件的审查大多用韩语。 由于配对者的关键词部分将结果与韩国的地面真实文本(Appendix A )进行比较,它可能会低估英语评论。 其他语言未经测试。

blocks.en: Generalization. The case studies are small: B1 and B2 showed ceiling effects, B3 has 12 articles from a single source, and in B5 one model returned no findings for one target. Our results are a snapshot of early-2026 models. A partial external-data check on ReaLMistake detector outputs (Appendix B ) neither replicates nor contradicts our main comparison.
blocks.zh: 通论. 案例研究规模小:B1和B2显示天花板效应,B3有12篇来自单一来源的文章,在B5中,有一个模型没有为一个目标返回任何发现. 我们的成果是2026年早期模型的一览。 对 ReaLMistake 检测器输出( Appendix B ) 进行部分外部数据检查,既不复制也不违背我们的主要比较.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Improved verification can catch errors in AI-generated code and analysis before they cause harm, but over-reliance is a risk: even our union approach matches only 56.7% of the planted errors under our automated matcher. We emphasize that our framework is intended to augment , not replace, human review; the undetected planted errors and the model-bias false positives (Section 5.8 ) underscore the continued importance of human judgment for high-stakes applications.
blocks.zh: 改进的核查可以捕捉AI生成的代码和分析中的错误,以免造成伤害,但过度依赖是一种风险:即使我们的联盟方法也只匹配我们自动匹配器下所埋设的56.7%的错误. 我们强调,我们的框架旨在增加而不是取代人文审查;未发现的人为错误和模式偏差假阳性(第5.8节)强调人类判断对高收量应用的持续重要性。

blocks.en: Use of AI Assistants
blocks.zh: 使用人工智能助理

blocks.en: AI tools were used throughout this work, and we report their use as part of the method. The artifacts, the injected errors, and the same-model baseline reviews were produced by Claude Opus 4.6 through the Claude Code agent tool; the cross-model reviews were produced by the listed reviewer models through their APIs. Claude Code was also used to write the analysis and audit scripts, to recompute every reported number from the per-session records, to check the manuscript against the raw data (which led to the corrections described in Section 4.1 ), and to draft and revise substantial parts of the text under the author’s direction. Every reference was checked for existence against bibliographic databases, and unresolved entries were checked by hand. The author reviewed the final text and takes full responsibility for all of its content.
blocks.zh: 在整个工作中使用了人工智能工具,我们报告将其作为方法的一部分。 文物,注射错误,以及同型基准审查由克劳德·奥普斯·4.6通过克劳德代码代理工具制作;跨型审查由列表的审查者模型通过他们的API制作. Claude Code还被用来撰写分析和审计脚本,重新计算每期记录中报告的每个数字,对照原始数据检查手稿(这导致了第4.1节所述的更正),并在作者的指导下起草和修订案文的大部分内容。 每一份参考文献都对照书目数据库加以核对,未解决的条目均由人工核对。 作者审查了最后案文,并对其所有内容承担全部责任。

blocks.en: Data and Code Availability
blocks.zh: 数据和代码可用性

blocks.en: The per-session review records, the 30 artifacts with their 150 ground-truth defect annotations, and the matching, aggregation, and audit scripts are available from the author on request. They include the per-session sets of detected ground-truth identifiers, which are what the union and Jaccard figures in Section 5.2 are computed from, so every set-level number in this paper can be recomputed independently.
blocks.zh: 每期审查记录、载有150份地面真相缺陷说明的30件文物以及匹配、汇总和审计脚本,可向作者索取。 它们包括每集被检测到的地面真实识别器,这是第5.2节中的工会和Jaccard数字的计算结果,因此本文中的每一个设定级别数字都可以独立重算。

blocks.en: Appendix A Benchmark, Ground Truth, and Matching
blocks.zh: 附录A 基准、地面真相和匹配

blocks.en: Artifacts. The generator produced 30 artifacts from fixed prompts, all in Korean: ten Python functions or classes (C1–C10; e.g., CSV statistics, business-day calculation, an LRU cache), ten technical tutorials (D1–D10; e.g., Docker Compose, a FastAPI CRUD service, JWT authentication), and ten presentation scripts (S1–S10; talks on AI tooling, open data, and automation).
blocks.zh: 人工兽 生成器用固定的提示器生产了30件文物,全部是韩文:十种Python函数或类(C1-C10;如CSV统计,商务日计算,LRU缓存),十种技术教程(D1-D10;如Docker Compakese,一种FastAPI CRUD服务,JWT认证)和十种演示文稿(S1-S10;关于AI工具化,开放数据,自动化的演讲).

blocks.en: Error injection and ground truth. Into each artifact, exactly five errors were injected, one of each type (FACT, CONS, CTXT, RCVR, MISS), giving 150 errors: 30 Critical, 60 Major, and 60 Minor. According to our run logs, injection was performed by the generator model in dedicated injection sessions. Each ground-truth record stores the location, the original and injected text, the type, the severity, a description, and the correct answer. The records were written at injection time; we did not run an independent annotation study, so the ground truth is a set of planted errors rather than an exhaustive list of all defects in each artifact.
blocks.zh: 注射错误和地面真相。 在每个文物中,总共注入了5个错误,其中1个类型(FACT、CONS、CTXT、RCVR、MISS),造成150个错误:30个关键错误、60个主要错误和60个次要错误。 根据我们的运行记录,注射是由 发电机模型在专用注射过程中进行。 每个地面真实记录存储着位置,原始文字和注入文字,类型,严重程度,描述,以及正确的答案. 记录是在注射时写的;我们没有进行独立的注解研究,所以地面的真相是一套埋设的错误,而不是每个文物中所有缺陷的详尽清单.

blocks.en: Matching. Each finding is scored against every ground-truth error of its artifact and assigned to the highest-scoring one if the score is at least 2.0: +3 if a line number in the finding’s location equals one in the error’s location, otherwise +1 if any are within five lines; plus 4 × 4\times the fraction of ground-truth keywords (tokens of three or more characters from the description, injected text, and correct answer) that appear in the finding’s description; plus 1 if the finding’s error type matches. Within one review, each ground-truth error is credited at most once, in the order findings are listed. Unmatched findings are counted as false positives, so precision and F1 are measured against the planted errors only; a finding that correctly identifies a pre-existing defect also counts as a false positive. A location match alone (3 points) clears the threshold, so the matcher can credit a finding that does not identify the error; we did not audit match accuracy by hand. The keyword component is language-sensitive (see Limitations).
blocks.zh: 相对. 每项发现都比照其文物的每个地面真实错误进行打分,如果得分至少为2.0:如果发现位置上的行号等于错误位置上的行号,则+3,否则+1,如果有在五行以内的话;加上4×4\乘以发现描述中出现的地面真实关键词的一小部分(来自描述的3个或3个以上字符的键盘,注入文字,以及正确的答案);加上发现错误类型匹配的1。 在一次审查中,每个地面真实错误最多记一次账,按结果顺序列出。 无法匹配的发现被算作是假阳性,因此精确度和F1只与植入的错误相比进行测量;正确识别一个先前存在的缺陷的发现也算作是假阳性. 仅一个位置匹配(3分)就可以清除阈值,因此匹配者可以将一个不能识别错误的发现记为信用;我们没有通过人工审核匹配的准确性. 关键词是语言敏感(见限制)。

blocks.en: Statistics. Per-condition means in Table 2 average the analysed sessions ( n n in the table). The primary test compares per-artifact means over the available runs against CCR (Wilcoxon signed-rank, 30 pairs, Holm over nine comparisons); run-1 paired t t -tests are shown for comparison with the original CCR report. Precision, recall, and F1 are computed per session and then averaged, so the reported F1 is not the harmonic mean of the reported precision and recall. Per-type recall uses each session’s single planted error of that type, so no session has an empty denominator.
blocks.zh: 统计。 附加条件在表2中指经分析的会议平均数(表n)。 初级测试比照CCR(Wilcoxon签名排名,30对,Holm比9对);运行-1对t - t测试与最初的CCR报告进行比较。 精确度、召回度和F1是按会话计算,然后平均计算,因此所报告的F1不是所报告的精确度和召回度的谐音平均值。 每类召回使用每个会话的单个植入错误类型,所以任何会话都没有空分母.

blocks.en: Appendix B External-Data Check on ReaLMistake
blocks.zh: 附录B ReaLMistake 外部数据检查

blocks.en: As a partial external-data check, we recomputed the two-review-call comparison on the public detector outputs of ReaLMistake ( Kamoi et al., 2024a ) , without new model calls. There, a “same-model review” is the responder model detecting errors in its own responses, the two same-model reviews differ only in prompt wording (temperature 0), and the cross-model partner is Claude 3 Opus. The analysis plan was committed to our version-controlled repository before the results were computed (available on request). Pooled over three tasks and two responder models (649 erroneous and 251 correct responses), union recall of the mixed pair was not detectably different from two same-model reviews ( + 0.5 +0.5 pp, 95% CI [ − 1.2 -1.2 , 2.2 2.2 ]; item bootstrap stratified by cell). In a post hoc split by responder, mixing raised recall for GPT-4 responses and lowered it for Llama-2-70B responses, and in every cell the false-positive rate moved in the same direction as recall, so the split is consistent with a shift in operating point rather than with added coverage alone. Two Claude 3 Opus reviews did not consistently trail the mixed pair, so the check does not separate model difference from reviewer capability. Because the unit (response-level binary labels), the source of variation between same-model reviews, the domain, and the detector generation (early 2024) all differ from our setting, this check neither replicates nor contradicts our main result.
blocks.zh: 作为部分外部数据检查,我们重新计算了ReaLMistake(Kamoi等人,2024a)的公共探测器输出量的两次审查-调用比较,没有新的模型调用。 在那里,“同型审查”是答复者发现自己答复中错误的模型,两个同型审查仅在即时措辞(温度0)上有所不同,跨型伙伴是Claude 3 Opus。 在计算结果之前,分析计划已投入我们版本控制的储存库(可索取)。 在三个任务和两个答复模式(649个错误和251个正确答复)的组合上,对混合配对的联盟召回与两个同型审查没有明显区别(+ 0.5+ 5页,95% CI [− 1.2-1.2,2.2 2.2];项靴子按单元格分级)。 在一次由应答者临时分拆后,混合引发了GPT-4响应的召回,并降低了Llama-2-70B响应的召回,在每个细胞中,假阳性率移动方向与召回方向相同,因此分拆符合操作点的转变,而不是单加覆盖. 两个克劳德 3 Opus评论没有连贯跟踪混合对子,因此检查没有将模型差异与审查者能力区分开来. 因为单位(应答级二进制标签),同型审查,域和探测器生成(2024年初)之间变化的源头都与我们的设定不同,所以这个检查既不复制也不违背我们的主要结果.

blocks.zh: 图2:所有10个条件的F1分(排名). 星号标志着唯一与CCR显著不同的条件(SR2;Wilcoxon在每条航线上签名-排行符,在可用跑道上,Holm调整p=0.011p=0.011);表2中的全部统计.

blocks.zh: 附录 D 有失败会话的数值计为零

blocks.zh: 表5对第4.1节排除和不包括的主要条件F1值进行了比较。 “所有会议”使SR运行3次,并将14次失败的跨模式会议评为没有结果的审查,这就是没有排除因素的数值如何计算。

blocks.en: Run-level F1 for the same-model conditions (30 artifacts each; runs 1/2/3) is: CCR 37.2/25.0/23.7, SR 25.7/28.6/(19.4, excluded), SA 23.8/20.8/26.9, and SR2 18.7/22.5/23.9. CCR ranks first among them in run 1 only, which is the run the original CCR report tested.

With all sessions, the primary test against CCR (Holm over nine comparisons) finds only SR2 different ( p = 0.011 p=0.011 ); SR’s unadjusted p p is 0.021 (0.26 after excluding its run 3), and XMR-GPT vs. XMR-Ge has unadjusted p = 0.071 p=0.071 (0.020 after excluding failures).

blocks.en: Appendix E Additional Discussion
blocks.zh: 附录E 其他讨论

blocks.en: E.1 Beyond Two Models: Diminishing Returns
blocks.zh: E.1 两种模式之外:收益减少

blocks.en: Our primary analysis is pairwise, but adding a third reviewer model yields diminishing returns. In Experiment A, the three-model union (CCR ∪ \cup XMR-GPT-R ∪ \cup XMR-GePro-R) reaches 58.0% recall (run 1), only 1.3pp over the two-model union (56.7%). In this setting, a third reviewer adds little.
blocks.zh: 我们的首要分析是双向的,但增加了第三个审查员模型,收益下降。 在实验A中,三模联盟(CCR \cup XMR-GPT-R \cup XMR-GePro-R)达到了58.0%的召回率(运行1),仅1.3pp超过两模联盟(56.7%). 在此情况下,第三审评人补充不多。

blocks.en: E.2 Perspective Diversification
blocks.zh: E.2 多样化观点

blocks.en: Our B5 case study further shows that prompt perspective diversification produces partly non-overlapping findings even within one model, though model diversification yields greater novelty (Table 6 ); the architect perspective yields the lowest inter-model overlap, suggesting that design-level assessment may benefit most from different models. One model’s anomalous zero-finding behavior cautions, however, that not all models respond uniformly to perspective variation.
blocks.zh: 我们的B5案例研究进一步表明,迅速的视角多样化即使在一个模式内也会产生部分非重叠的结论,尽管模式多样化产生更大的新颖性(表6);建筑师的观点产生最低的模型间重叠,表明设计层面的评估可能从不同的模式中受益最大。 然而,一个模型的反常的零调查行为告诫说,并非所有模型都对视角差异作出一致的反应。

blocks.en: Appendix F Case Studies in Full
blocks.zh: 附录F 案例研究全文

blocks.en: F.1 Setup
blocks.zh: F.1 设置

blocks.en: To assess generalizability beyond code review, we conduct five case studies (B5’s setup is given with its results):
blocks.zh: 为了评估守则审查以外的普遍性,我们进行了五个案例研究(B5的设置及其结果):

blocks.en: B1: Agricultural price anomaly detection. From national open-data agricultural auction records (2022–2026, 1,155 trading days, 15 commodities), we flagged 15 candidate anomalies via Z-score ( | z | > 3 |z|>3 ) and IQR intersection and added 3 normal-range controls; one annotator labeled the candidates by hand (14 true anomalies, 1 uncertain). Both same-model and cross-model reviewers analyzed each.
blocks.zh: B1:农业价格异常检测. 从国家开放数据农业拍卖记录(2022–2026,1,155交易日,15种商品),我们通过Z分数(QQ z > > 3 |z|>3)和IQR交叉点标注了15个候选异常点,并增加了3个正常距离控制点;1名注释员用手标注了候选者(14个真实异常点,1个不确定点). 同型和跨型审查员都对每个都进行了分析.

blocks.en: B2: Economic recession identification. Using macroeconomic time series (GDP growth, unemployment, yield-curve spread, Sahm Rule indicator; 1960–2025), we designed six tasks requiring recession-period identification, with official government-designated dates as ground truth.
blocks.zh: B2:经济衰退识别. 我们利用宏观经济时间序列(GDP增长、失业、收益曲线分布、Sahm Rule指标;1960–2025)设计了六项任务,需要确定衰退期,政府官方指定的日期为基本真相。

blocks.en: B3: News fact-checking. Using 12 PolitiFact-verified articles across six topic areas (ratings: Half True 4, Mostly False 3, False 3, Pants on Fire 2), the generator analyzed each article’s claims; three reviewer conditions (CCR, XMR-GPT, XMR-Ge) each reviewed all 12 three times (108 reviews total), against 43 ground-truth errors from PolitiFact’s analyses.
blocks.zh: B3:新闻事实检查. 使用12篇PoliticalFact验证文章, 涵盖6个主题领域(评价:半真实 4, 大部分是假 3, False 3, Pants on Fire 2),

blocks.en: B4: Meta case study—reviewing this paper’s code. We applied same-model review (fresh session) and cross-model review to the visualization code written for this paper’s figures, providing a qualitative illustration of the non-overlap measured quantitatively in Experiment A.
blocks.zh: B4:Meta案例研究——审查本文的代码。 我们用同样的模式审查(新会议)和跨模式审查为本文的数字撰写的可视化代码,从质量上说明了在实验A中以数量衡量的非重叠。

blocks.en: F.2 Results
blocks.zh: F.2 结果

blocks.en: B1: Agricultural anomaly detection. All conditions classified all 17 cases with a definite label correctly (14 true anomalies and 3 normal controls); the one case the annotator marked uncertain was treated the same way by every condition and is not scored. The anomalies involved extreme price spikes ( z > 3 z>3 , increases of 42–138%) unambiguous to any capable model.
blocks.zh: B1:农业异常检测. 所有条件都对所有17个有明确标签的病例进行了正确分类(14个真正的异常和3个正常控制);其中1个情况是,每个情况都以同样的方式对待标注不确定的注释者,没有打分。 这些异常情况涉及任何有能力的模型都毫不含糊地出现极端价格飙升(z > 3 z > 3,上升42-138 %)。

blocks.en: B2: Economic recession identification. Similarly, all conditions reached 100% accuracy across 6 tasks, correctly identifying all officially designated recession periods; timing error was 0 months (same-model) and 0.2 months (cross-model).
blocks.zh: B2:经济衰退识别. 同样,在6项任务中,所有条件都达到了100%的准确度,正确确定了所有官方指定的衰退期;计时错误为0个月(同型)和0.2个月(跨型)。

blocks.en: B3: News fact-checking. To test generalization beyond software artifacts, we conducted a fact-checking case study with 12 PolitiFact-verified articles (43 ground-truth errors, 108 reviews). The reviewer conditions achieved F1 of 20.7% (CCR), 24.4% (XMR-GPT), and 23.8% (XMR-Ge), with XMR-GPT highest in recall (76.7%, vs. 55.8% for CCR and 51.2% for XMR-Ge); precision was low (12.7–15.5%) in all conditions. The union recall of CCR and XMR-GPT reached 86.0% (Jaccard 54.1%; 3-way union 88.4%). Because each condition’s recall already pools its three runs, this union pools six reviews against three and is not a matched-call comparison; we report it descriptively.
blocks.zh: B3:新闻事实检查. 为了测试软件文物以外的一般化,我们用12篇Political Fact验证文章(43个地面真相错误,108个评论)进行了事实核查案例研究。 审查者的条件达到F1,即20.7%(CCR)、24.4%(XMR-GPT)和23.8%(XMR-Ge),XMR-GPT召回率最高(76.7%,对55.8%的CCR和51.2%的XMR-Ge);在所有条件下精确度都很低(12.7-15.5%)。 工会召回了CCR和XMR-GPT,达到86.0%(Jaccar54.1%;3路工会88.4%). 因为每个条件的召回已经集中了三轮,这个工会集中了六轮检讨和三轮检讨,并不是一个对等的检讨比较;我们以描述性的方式报告。

blocks.en: The fact-checking results resemble Experiment A’s key patterns in a non-software domain: in both settings the top-tier cross-model reviewer has the highest individual F1 (Experiment A overall 32.3% vs. CCR 28.6%, not significant; fact-check 24.4% vs. 20.7%, untested), and neither shows ceiling effects. The higher Jaccard in fact-checking (54.1% vs. 41.2%) may indicate that some errors are detectable across models; the fact-checking union (pooled over runs) is not comparable with Experiment A’s call-matched union, and sample composition, detection rates, and matching also differ between the two settings, and B3 has only 12 articles.
blocks.zh: 事实检查结果与实验A在非软件领域的关键模式相似:在两种情况下,顶级跨模型审查员拥有最高的个人F1(实验A总体32.3%对CCR28.6%,并不重要;事实检查24.4%对20.7%,未经测试),也没有显示上限效应。 事实检查中较高的Jaccard(54.1%对41.2%)可能表明,在模型中可以发现一些错误;事实检查结合(集中运行)与实验A的调用结合不相称,样本组成、检测率和匹配率也因两种环境而异,B3只有12篇文章。

blocks.en: Interpretation of B1, B2, and B3. B1 and B2 do not discriminate between conditions. One untested possibility is that differences appear only on judgment-intensive tasks; we did not manipulate or measure task difficulty. In these two cases, where the signal was strong (extreme price spikes, well-documented recessions), every condition we tested succeeded. The differences measured in Experiment A and B3, where review requires nuanced judgment about correctness, consistency, and completeness, may represent the regime where independence dimensions matter. B3 suggests that this regime is not specific to software artifacts: fact-checking of news claims produces similar qualitative patterns.
blocks.zh: 对B1,B2和B3. B1和B2的解释并不区分条件. 一个未经检验的可能性是,分歧只出现在判断密集型的任务上;我们没有操纵或衡量任务难度。 在这两种情况中,信号很强(价格飙升,有据可查的衰退),我们测试的每一个条件都成功。 在试验A和B3中测量到的差异,如果审查要求对正确性、一致性和完整性作出细微的判断,则可能代表独立性层面重要的制度。 B3暗示这种制度并非软件文物所特有的:对新闻诉求进行事实检查会产生类似的定性模式.

blocks.en: B4: Meta case study. Same-model and cross-model review independently examined our visualization code (2 Python files, ∼ \sim 600 lines): same-model review found 15 issues (2 P1, 8 P2, 5 P3) and the cross-model reviewer 6 (3 P1, 3 P2), with 4 in common (Jaccard = 4/17 = 23.5%). Same-model review excelled at depth (subtle logic inconsistencies, convention violations), while the cross-model reviewer caught critical edge cases, including a crash-inducing path missed entirely by same-model review.
blocks.zh: B4:Meta案例研究. 同型和跨型审查独立审查我们的可视化代码(2 Python文件,\\sim 600行):同型审查发现15期(2 P1,8 P2,5 P3)和跨型审查员6期(3 P1,3 P2),4期为共通(Jaccard = 4/17 = 23.5%). 同一种模式审查在深度上表现优异(低度逻辑不一致,违反公约),而跨模式审查员抓住了关键边缘案件,包括完全被同一种模式审查错过的坠机路径。

blocks.en: In a second round reviewing this paper’s draft text, same-model review found 27 issues and the cross-model reviewer 15; we no longer have the cluster-level records for this round and do not report an overlap figure for it. The qualitative pattern held: same-model review caught cross-referencing and framework-consistency errors, the cross-model reviewer flagged overclaiming and source-traceability gaps. The code-review overlap (23.5%), below the 41.2% in Experiment A, suggests overlap may vary with task characteristics, though B4 is a qualitative demonstration rather than a statistical test.
blocks.zh: 在第二轮审查这份文件的草案案文时,同一种模式的审查发现27个问题和交叉模式审查员15个问题;我们不再掌握这一轮的分组记录,也不报告重叠数字。 所持的质量模式:同一模式审查发现相互参照和框架一致性错误,跨模式审查员标出过高的称谓和源追踪差距。 代码审查重叠(23.5%)低于实验A中的41.2%,这表明重叠可能因任务特征而异,尽管B4是一种质的演示而不是统计测试.

blocks.en: B5: Security audit perspective diversification. To test whether varying the perspective (rather than the model) produces independent value even within the same model, we conducted a security audit on two C libraries (wren, 8.9K lines; cgltf, 3.1K lines) reviewed by three frontier models from distinct families under three perspectives: attacker (exploit-focused), defender (mitigation-focused), and architect (design-level). Findings were matched by file, function, and CWE category.
blocks.zh: B5:安全审计观点多样化。 为了检验不同视角(而不是模型)是否在同一个模式内产生独立价值,我们对两个C库(wren, 8.9K线;cgltf, 3.1K线)进行了安全审计,由来自三个视角下不同家庭的3个前沿模式审查:攻击者(以开发为重点)、捍卫者(以缓解为重点)和建筑师(设计级别)。 调查结果与文件、功能和CWE类别相匹配。

blocks.en: Table 6: Perspective vs. model diversification Jaccard overlap (lower means less overlap).
blocks.zh: 表6:视角与模式多样化Jaccard重叠(较低意味着重叠较少)。

blocks.en: Both diversification axes produce low overlap (Table 6 ), below the 41.2% CCR–XMR overlap observed in Experiment A, indicating partly non-overlapping findings; low overlap alone does not show that the additional findings are correct. Mean inter-model overlap is about a third lower than inter-perspective overlap ( J = 0.152 J=0.152 vs. 0.228 0.228 ), consistent with changing the model producing more distinct findings than changing the prompt alone.
blocks.zh: 两个多样化轴产生较低的重叠(表6),低于实验A中观测到的41.2%的CCRQMR重叠,表明部分结论没有重叠;单是低重叠并不表明额外结论是正确的. 平均型号间重叠大约比跨型号重叠低三分之一(J = 0.152 J = 0.152 vs. 0.228 0.228),这与改变型号,产生比改变单型更明显的结论一致.

blocks.en: The architect (design-level) perspective produces the lowest inter-model Jaccard ( J = 0.075 J=0.075 ; wren 0.082, cgltf 0.068) and the attacker perspective the highest (wren 0.208, cgltf 0.157), suggesting that exploit-oriented analysis follows relatively standardized patterns across models while design-level reasoning is more model-specific. In finding counts, perspective diversification within a single model yielded +98–118% additional findings via union, and model diversification within a single perspective yielded +117%. These are counts of findings, not validated defects, and we did not measure the union across all nine model–perspective combinations.
blocks.zh: 建筑师(设计级别)视角产生最低的模型间Jaccard(J = 0.075 J = 0.075;wren 0.082,cgltf 0.068),攻击者视角产生最高的(wren 0.208,cgltf 0.157),暗示以开发为导向的分析遵循了跨模型的相对标准化模式,而设计级别推理则更符合模型的具体情况. 在寻找数字时,单一模式中的视角多样化通过工会得出了+98-118 %的额外结论,单一视角中的模式多样化得出+117%。 这些是调查结果,不是经过验证的缺陷,我们也没有对所有9种模式的结合进行衡量。

blocks.en: One anomaly limits generality: one model produced zero findings for the smaller target (cgltf, 3.1K lines) under the defender and architect perspectives while functioning normally otherwise, indicating that some models’ responsiveness to perspective variation depends on target characteristics. Overall, perspective diversification is a complementary, not competing, axis to model diversification; while two targets are a limited sample, the consistent patterns suggest their combination may offer richer coverage than either alone.
blocks.zh: 一个异常现象限制了一般性:一个模型对捍卫者和建筑师视角下的较小目标(cgltf,3.1K线)产生零发现,而正常运行时则不然,表明一些模型对视角差异的反应取决于目标特征. 总体而言,观点多样化是多样化模式的一个互补而不是相互竞争的轴心;虽然两个目标只是有限的样本,但一贯的模式表明,两者的结合可能比单独两个目标都更丰富。
